student_will_learn: Explain the three CloudWatch alarm states and what triggers each
Connect an alarm to an SNS topic to deliver notifications
Explain what a composite alarm is and why it reduces noise
Configure a consecutive-datapoint threshold to avoid alerting on a single blip
Identify why overly sensitive alarms lead to alert fatigue and ignored alerts

ava_lesson_intro.ava_speaks: Last lesson-ல நாம metrics, logs, dashboards பார்த்தோம் - இப்போ team-க்கு system health தெரியும். ஆனா Deepak Menon-ஓட FQ-203 ticket-ல அடுத்த கேள்வி - 'Dashboard-ஐ யாராவது 24/7 வெறுங்க பார்த்துண்டே இருக்க முடியுமா? ஏதாவது problem வந்தா, automatic-ஆ team-க்கு தெரியப்படுத்த முடியுமா?' இதுதான் இன்னைக்கு நாம கத்துக்கப் போற CloudWatch Alarms மற்றும் SNS.

lines: Building Basics · Session CS6 · Lesson C6.2
Ticket FQ-203 — continuing with Deepak Menon

blocks.block_title: Alarm States and How They Trigger Actions
blocks.ava_speaks: CloudWatch Alarm-ல 3 states இருக்கும் - OK (metric threshold-க்குள்ள இருக்கு, எல்லாம் நல்லா இருக்கு), ALARM (metric threshold-ஐ மீறிடுச்சு, problem இருக்கு), INSUFFICIENT_DATA (alarm-ஐ evaluate பண்ண போதுமான data இல்ல, example: instance புது-ஆ launch ஆனது). Alarm state மாறும்போது (OK -> ALARM), அது ஒரு action trigger பண்ணலாம் - பொதுவா SNS (Simple Notification Service) topic-க்கு ஒரு message publish பண்றது, அது email, SMS, அல்லது Slack integration வழியா team-க்கு notification அனுப்பும்.

rows: Metric is within the defined threshold — everything is normal
Metric has breached the threshold — action triggers here
Not enough data points yet to evaluate the alarm (e.g. a brand-new instance)

board_actions.text: An alarm's transition INTO the ALARM state is what typically triggers an SNS notification — not every evaluation, just the state change.

inline_questions.question: ஒரு EC2 instance, இப்போதுதான் launch ஆச்சு, இன்னும் metrics report பண்ணல. அதோட CPUUtilization alarm என்ன state-ல இருக்கும்?
options: D) Alarm state assign ஆகவே ஆகாது
inline_questions.ava_correct: Correct! Metrics இன்னும் report ஆகாததால, alarm-க்கு evaluate பண்ண போதுமான data இல்ல - இது INSUFFICIENT_DATA state-ல இருக்கும், OK-லோ ALARM-லோ இல்ல.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, data இல்லாத நிலையில், alarm 'OK'nு assume பண்ணாது - அது INSUFFICIENT_DATA state-ல இருக்கும், அதாவது evaluate பண்ண போதுமான information இன்னும் வரல.

inline_questions.question: Alarm state OK-ல இருந்து ALARM-க்கு மாறுது. Typically என்ன நடக்கும்?
options: A) ஒண்ணுமே நடக்காது, manual-ஆ யாராவது check பண்ணனும்
B) SNS topic-க்கு ஒரு message publish ஆகும், அது configured subscribers-க்கு notification அனுப்பும்
inline_questions.ava_correct: Sari! Alarm state change (OK -> ALARM), configured action-ஐ trigger பண்ணும் - பொதுவா SNS topic-க்கு publish பண்றது, அது team-க்கு notification (email/SMS/Slack) அனுப்பும்.
inline_questions.ava_wrong: இல்ல, alarm state change ஒரு action trigger பண்ணும் - manual checking-ஐ மட்டும் நம்பாம, SNS topic-க்கு automatic-ஆ publish பண்ணி, team-க்கு proactive-ஆ notify பண்ணும்.

blocks.block_title: Composite Alarms — Reducing Noise by Combining Signals
blocks.ava_speaks: ஒரு single metric-ஐ மட்டும் வெச்சு alarm பண்றது, பல false positives கொடுக்கும் - example, high CPU மட்டும் ஒரு issue இல்லாம இருக்கலாம் (batch job run ஆகுது). Composite Alarms, multiple individual alarms-ஐ combine பண்ணி, ஒரு single, more meaningful alert தரும் - example: 'High CPU AND High Error Rate AND Low Healthy Host Count' மூணும் ஒரே சமயத்துல true ஆனா மட்டும் ஒரு real incident-nு treat பண்ணு. Freshworks மாதிரி companies, composite alarms use பண்ணி, individual noisy alarms-ஐ, ஒரு clean, actionable signal-ஆ மாத்துறாங்க.

rows: Fires on one condition alone — CPU high (could be a batch job, not an incident)
Fires only when multiple conditions align — CPU high AND error rate high AND healthy hosts low
Much more likely to represent a genuine incident

blocks.block_title: Setting Up an Alarm With SNS Notification and a Consecutive-Datapoint Threshold
blocks.ava_speaks: karthik-dev இப்போ FoodQuick-ஓட app servers-க்கு ஒரு high-error-rate alarm configure பண்றான், SNS notification-கூட, single-blip false alerts தவிர்க்க consecutive-datapoint threshold-கூட.

steps.ava_narration: முதல்ல SNS Console-ல ஒரு topic create பண்றோம் - 'foodquick-oncall-alerts'nு பேரு வெச்சு.

console_action.result: An SNS topic is created, ready to have subscribers added

steps.ava_narration: இந்த topic-க்கு, on-call team-ஓட email address-ஐ subscribe பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: The on-call team will now receive an email whenever a message is published to this topic

steps.ava_narration: CloudWatch Console-ல, 'Create alarm' click பண்ணி, metric-ஆ ALB-ஓட HTTPCode_Target_5XX_Count select பண்றோம்.

console_action.result: The alarm will monitor 5xx error responses from the ALB's target servers

steps.ava_narration: Threshold-ஆ, 'greater than 10' கொடுக்கிறோம், ஆனா முக்கியமா - 'Datapoints to alarm' 3 out of 3-ஆ set பண்றோம். இதுன்னா, consecutive-ஆ 3 மணி நேர periods-லயும் threshold மீறினா தான் alarm trigger ஆகும், ஒரு single spike-க்கு அல்ல.

console_action.result: The alarm will only fire after 3 consecutive evaluation periods breach the threshold, filtering out single, brief spikes

steps.ava_narration: Notification action-ஆ, foodquick-oncall-alerts SNS topic-ஐ select பண்றோம். Alarm create பண்றோம்.

console_action.highlight: SNS topic selection for alarm action
console_action.result: The alarm is now live — a sustained error spike will notify the on-call team automatically, while a brief single blip will not

expected_outcome.description: The on-call team is now automatically notified via SNS when 5xx errors sustain above threshold for 3 consecutive periods, without being paged for a single momentary spike.
expected_outcome.what_to_notice: Datapoints to alarm '3 out of 3' setting, இதுதான் single-blip false alerts-ஐ தடுக்கும் key setting - இது இல்லாம இருந்தா, ஒரே ஒரு momentary spike-கு கூட alarm fire ஆயிடும்.

blocks.block_title: How the Consecutive-Datapoint Threshold Filters Noise
blocks.ava_speaks: இந்த diagram பாரு - ஒரே ஒரு blip, ஏன் alarm trigger பண்ணாதுனு காட்டுது.

ascii: Alarm setting: threshold > 10 errors, Datapoints to alarm: 3 out of 3
Period 1: 15 errors (breach) -> alarm state: still evaluating, not yet ALARM
Period 2: 3 errors (no breach) -> counter resets, still OK
Period 3: 12 errors (breach) -> only 1 consecutive breach so far, still OK
Period 3: 20 errors (breach) -> 3 CONSECUTIVE breaches -> alarm fires, SNS notification sent

output_preview.ava_narration: ஒரே ஒரு momentary spike, alarm-ஐ trigger பண்ணாது - consecutive-ஆ 3 periods-லயும் threshold மீறினா தான் real signal-nு treat ஆகும்.

blocks.block_title: Your Turn — Build a Composite Alarm for a Genuine Incident Signal
blocks.instruction: FoodQuick-ஓட payment service-க்கு, ஒரு composite alarm design பண்ணு - individual metric noise-ஐ தவிர்த்து, genuine incidents-ஐ மட்டும் catch பண்ண.
blocks.scenario: Deepak Menon, தனித்தனி alarms (high CPU, high error rate, low healthy hosts) ஒவ்வொண்ணும் தனியா false-positive alerts கொடுத்திட்டு இருக்குனு flag பண்ணி இருக்காங்க. அவங்க ஒரு composite alarm வேணும் - மூணு conditions-மும் ஒரே சமயத்துல true ஆனா மட்டும் trigger ஆகணும்.

starter_state.console_open: CloudWatch Console → Alarms → Create composite alarm
starter_state.current_configuration: Three individual alarms already exist: foodquick-payment-high-cpu, foodquick-payment-high-error-rate, foodquick-payment-low-healthy-hosts. No composite alarm has been created yet.

requirements: Create a composite alarm combining all three individual alarms
Use AND logic so the composite alarm only fires when ALL THREE individual alarms are in ALARM state simultaneously
Connect the composite alarm's action to the foodquick-oncall-alerts SNS topic
Leave the three individual alarms as they are — they still exist independently, just no longer each independently paging the team
hints: Composite alarm rule expression AND operator use பண்ணி, மூணு alarm names-ஐயும் combine பண்ணு - example: ALARM(foodquick-payment-high-cpu) AND ALARM(foodquick-payment-high-error-rate) AND ALARM(foodquick-payment-low-healthy-hosts)
SNS action-ஐ, individual alarms-ல இருந்து அல்ல, composite alarm-ல தான் attach பண்ணு - இதுதான் noise reduce பண்ணும் core idea
Individual alarms delete பண்ண வேண்டாம் - composite alarm அவற்றை reference பண்ணும், அவை exist பண்ணனும்

expected_outcome.verifiable_result: A composite alarm exists with an AND expression referencing all three individual alarms, with SNS notification action attached only to the composite alarm
expected_outcome.ava_correct: Correct! இப்போ team, மூணு conditions-மும் align ஆகும்போது மட்டும் notify ஆவாங்க - இது genuine incident-க்கான signal, single noisy metric இல்ல.
expected_outcome.ava_wrong: Composite alarm expression-ஐ ஒரு தடவை check பண்ணு - AND logic use பண்ணியிருக்கானு, மூணு alarms-ஐயும் reference பண்ணியிருக்கானு பாரு.

blocks.block_title: The 3am Page for a Momentary CPU Spike
blocks.ava_speaks: priya-dev, ஒரு CPU alarm set பண்றப்போ, Datapoints to alarm-ஐ default '1 out of 1'-ஆ விட்டுட்டா - அதாவது ஒரே ஒரு evaluation period threshold மீறினாலும், உடனே alarm fire ஆகும். என்ன ஆச்சுனு பாருங்க.
blocks.setup: priya-dev sets up a CPU utilization alarm on the production database, leaving the default 'Datapoints to alarm' at 1 out of 1, meaning any single momentary CPU spike above the threshold immediately triggers the alarm.
blocks.what_happened: A brief, harmless CPU spike (caused by a routine scheduled backup job that lasts about 90 seconds) triggers the alarm at 3am, paging the on-call engineer for something that resolved itself before they even opened their laptop. This happens repeatedly, several nights a week.
blocks.broken_config:
Alarm: foodquick-db-cpu-alarm
Threshold: > 80% CPU
Datapoints to alarm: 1 out of 1 (fires on a single breach, no consecutive requirement)
Actual pattern: brief nightly backup job routinely spikes CPU above 80% for under 2 minutes, then returns to normal
blocks.error_shown: PagerDuty history: foodquick-db-cpu-alarm has fired 14 times in the last 3 weeks, all between 2:45-3:15am, all auto-resolved within 3 minutes with no manual intervention needed. On-call engineer has started muting notifications from this alarm on their phone.
blocks.the_real_problem: '1 out of 1' setting, ஒரே ஒரு momentary spike-க்கும், ஒரு real sustained problem-க்கும் இடையே வித்தியாசம் பார்க்காது. Repeated false alerts-ஓட real danger என்னனா, engineers eventually notifications-ஐ mute பண்ணி விடுவாங்க - இது 'alert fatigue' - ஒரு real incident வந்தாலும், அதை miss பண்ணும் risk உருவாகும்.

fix.corrected_config: Change Datapoints to alarm from '1 out of 1' to '3 out of 3' (or similar), so only a SUSTAINED high-CPU period triggers the page, not a brief, expected spike from a known routine job.
fix.result: The nightly backup job no longer triggers false pages, on-call engineers stop muting this alarm, and the alarm becomes trustworthy again — meaning a real page is taken seriously.

blocks.lesson: Alarm sensitivity default settings ('1 out of 1'), ஒரு single momentary blip-ஐயும், ஒரு real sustained problem-ஐயும் ஒரே மாதிரி treat பண்ணும் - இது repeated false alerts-க்கு வழிவகுக்கும், engineers eventually alarms-ஐ mute பண்ணி, real incidents-ஐ miss பண்ண ஆரம்பிப்பாங்க.

challenges.question: A payment processing failure alarm needs to page the on-call team IMMEDIATELY, even for a single failed transaction, since every failure has real financial impact. Should this alarm use a high 'Datapoints to alarm' setting like the CPU example?
challenges.answer: No — the consecutive-datapoint pattern that prevents alert fatigue on noisy metrics like CPU isn't universally correct. For a metric where even one occurrence is genuinely significant and actionable (like a payment failure), '1 out of 1' can be the RIGHT choice. The datapoints setting should match the actual severity and noise profile of what's being measured, not be applied as a blanket rule everywhere.

challenges.question: A team has 5 separate alarms all related to the same underlying database, each independently paging the on-call engineer during an outage, resulting in 5 near-simultaneous pages for one incident. What CloudWatch feature directly addresses this?
challenges.answer: A composite alarm — combining the 5 individual alarms into one composite alarm (with appropriate logic, likely OR since any of the 5 conditions indicates the same underlying database problem) means the team gets ONE clear notification representing the incident, instead of 5 separate, confusing pages.

challenges.question: An SNS topic has 8 email subscribers but no SMS or Slack integration. During a critical 3am incident, is email alone likely to reliably wake someone up?
challenges.answer: Probably not reliably — email notifications are easy to miss, especially overnight, since most phones don't have urgent-priority alerting for email by default. For critical on-call pages, SMS or a dedicated paging integration (like PagerDuty or Opsgenie via SNS) is much more likely to actually reach someone in time.

blocks.block_title: How Teams Tune Alarms to Stay Trustworthy Over Time
blocks.ava_speaks: Real companies-ல, alarm configuration ஒரு 'set once' task இல்ல - Deepak Menon மாதிரி DevOps leads, alarm effectiveness-ஐ தொடர்ந்து review பண்றாங்க, false-positive rate high-ஆ இருக்கறதா-ன்னு.

workflow_steps.action: Track each alarm's false-positive rate over time — how often it fires without a corresponding real, actionable issue
workflow_steps.detail: இது priya-dev-ஓட 3am mistake மாதிரி noisy alarms-ஐ, patterns-ஆ ஆவதுக்கு முன்னாடியே கண்டுபிடிக்க உதவும்

workflow_steps.action: Regularly review which alarms team members have muted or snoozed, treating that as a signal the alarm needs re-tuning, not that it's safe to ignore
workflow_steps.detail: Muted notifications, unresolved alarm design problems-ஐ hide பண்ணிடும் - இதை proactively கண்டுபிடிக்கணும்

workflow_steps.action: Use composite alarms deliberately for any incident pattern that genuinely involves multiple correlated conditions, rather than accumulating many independent single-metric alarms
workflow_steps.detail: இது alert volume-ஐ overall கம்மி பண்ணி, ஒவ்வொரு page-மும் meaningful-ஆ இருக்கறதை உறுதி பண்ணும்

tools_shown.use: ஒவ்வொரு alarm-ஓட state transitions history-ஐ காட்டி, false-positive patterns identify பண்ண உதவும்
Critical alarms-க்கு, email-ஐ விட reliable-ஆ, escalation policies-கூட urgent paging தரும்

lesson_summary.ava_speaks: Super! இன்னைக்கு நாம alarm states, SNS notification setup, composite alarms, consecutive-datapoint thresholds எல்லாம் கத்துக்கிட்டோம். மிக முக்கியமா, overly sensitive alarms, alert fatigue-க்கு வழிவகுத்து, engineers real incidents-ஐயும் miss பண்ண ஆரம்பிப்பாங்க-னு உறுதியா கத்துக்கிட்ட. அடுத்த lesson-ல நாம CloudTrail Audit பார்ப்போம் - every API call எப்படி track ஆகும்னு.

board.title: Lesson C6.2 — Summary
points: ✓ CloudWatch alarms have three states: OK, ALARM, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA
✓ SNS delivers alarm notifications via email, SMS, or integrations like PagerDuty
✓ Composite alarms combine multiple conditions into one meaningful signal, reducing noise
✓ A consecutive-datapoint threshold prevents a single momentary blip from triggering a full alert
✓ Overly sensitive alarms cause alert fatigue — engineers start muting notifications, risking missed real incidents
